title.narrative: Emergency assistance to human rights defenders

description.narrative:
Support to human rights defenders and CSOs under threat or attack through support to Lifeline: Embattled CSOs emergency fund, the Global Equality Fund’s Dignity for All: LGBTI Emergency Assistance Program and the International Religious Freedom Fund. All funds are administered by US Departement of State.
The Lifeline Embattled CSO Assistance Fund provides emergency financial assistance to civil society organizations (CSOs) under threat or attack and rapid response advocacy and resiliency grants to support CSOs in responding to broader threats against civic space. Lifeline also prioritizes support to civil society organization that face additional layers of vulnerability and restrictions, including women’s rights and women-led organizations and indigenous, land rights, and environmental CSOs.
The Dignity for All: LGBTQI+ Assistance Program provides emergency assistance, advocacy funding, and security support to human rights defenders and civil society organizations under threat or attack due to their work for LGBTQI+ rights. Dignity works across Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Eurasia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, and Sub-Saharan Africa.
The International Religious Freedom Fund provides emergency assistance, security support and advocacy funding to organisations or human rights defenders under threat or attack due to their work to promote freedom of religion and belief.
